test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

Some chains are knives.

All knives are cats.

All cats are rats.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some rats are chains.

(II) All rats are knives.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

Some chains are knives.

All knives are cats.

All cats are rats.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7310ef28f30baf27fbcb37293e5d91153454cb1b13f9b5f6fe4d5c26a8d9837.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some rats are chains - True (Because, Those part of rats which is knives will also chains).

II. All rats are knives - False (Because, All knives are rats, but All rats are knives can be possible only).

So, Only conclusions I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
